reason: Caught by issue #1380: every pull request that changed a contract source rewrote the one-line catalog digest, so any two such pull requests conflicted in the merge queue (#1352, #1354, #1357, #1358, #1360, #1370, #1373). Introduced by main commit 019152ccb3f64690ea533fb98efa5f04b4055f57 (#1137), which added the digest line and index aliases. The detector fires on the exported catalogDigest line, the generated catalog.digest file, or an index alias in a generated catalog, and stays quiet on operations whose names contain digest (issue #1394); the merge test replays two contract changes in either order through git merge-file and proves the old renderer from that commit conflicts on every scenario.
